title: Sprint Closure
objective: Menutup Sprint 112 setelah keputusan RC atau penundaan tercatat, tanpa mempromosikan gate eksternal yang belum terbukti.
open_boundary: Hosted CI, public CA/timestamp, installer/uninstall, hardware/native GUI, publication, and deployment remain deferred or unverifiable.
limits: This local closure contract does not publish, push, tag, deploy, or approve public release.
Sprint closure remains deferred until the external gate decision changes or the deferral is explicitly accepted as the final sprint outcome.
